meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你说要做发布前检查时,Claude 会先找出上次 npm 发布以来的代码改动,再同时派出最多 16 个后台检查员(10 个查每组改动、5 个查整体质量、1 个综合评估),最后报告:可否发布、版本号建议、破坏性变更和变更日志草稿。
howto.when: 只在你说出“pre-publish review”“ready to publish?”等发布前审查要求时触发;普通发布请求不会触发,会直接发布。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude detects changes since last npm release, spawns up to 16 reviewers (10 per-change, 5 holistic, 1 oracle), then outputs release readiness, version bump, breaking changes, changelog draft.
howto.when_en: Runs only on explicit pre-publish review requests (e.g. 'pre-publish review', 'release review', 'safe to publish'). Plain publish requests must NOT trigger it; /publish ships directly.
